_about: The nine scheduled tasks this engine runs as, in one place. A Codex session asked to "create the automations" builds them from this file (AGENTS.md, "When Krish says: create the automations"); the README table is the same list for reading. Times are New York (America/New_York), except the conversion slot, which runs the weekly live-browser channel audit under the 2026-10-21 ruling at Saturday 12:00 Europe/London; its own timezone overrides the default.
run_in: this local project (not a new worktree), so every run shares the lists and the token file
access: network on (the public feed, the channels, controlcenter.krishraja.com); the signed-in browser when available

automations.name: Growth: weekly channel audit
automations.prompt: Run jobs/conversion.md as AGENTS.md says, starting with jobs/channel-audit.md. Apply only standing-authority existing-field browser repairs; verify saved-page readback. Hold creative, re-upload, bio, positioning and pin changes for approval. Keep incomplete account windows open.
